confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied comparables; no web search was used for city-price anchors, and no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are the firmer figures; the three-star hotel and drink anchors carry wider uncertainty (roughly plus or minus 20%). Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor (about 2x draft beer) because direct price knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from RBA exchange-rate pages as surfaced in search summaries; the 15 October figure appeared only on the RBA statistics table among the pages found, and I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Primary basis is Penang, Malaysia (same country, similar tourist price tier), with Kuala Lumpur set roughly 6-25% above Penang for its larger hotel and dining market. Nha Trang and Vientiane were used only as regional sanity checks. Cocktail and wine anchors use the beer relationship as the disclosed basis.
